items.title: Rufus Reid interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, GA, January 4, 2013
items.q: And so I had to clean house a little bit, and Marty taught me how to deal with the academia.

ctx.x: Bigger than you can even imagine, than we even imagined. Marty Krivin, I was with Thad Jones/Mel Lewis Orchestra. And Thad was Artist-in-Residence at William Paterson University. At that time it was William Paterson College. And the two years I was with the band we would go as a quartet, out and do workshops, master classes if you will, maybe twice a semester. And this gentleman, Dr. Martin Krivin, was very observant. Because Harold Danko would talk a little bit about the piano and I would talk about the bass,…
